entries.name: Dwarf
entries.summary: Your dwarf character has an assortment of inborn abilities, part and parcel of dwarven nature.

entries.name: Age
entries.text: Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans, but they’re considered young until they reach the age of 50. On average, they live about 350 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries.text: Most dwarves are lawful, believing firmly in the benefits of a well-ordered society. They tend toward good as well, with a strong sense of fair play and a belief that everyone deserves to share in the benefits of a just order.

entries.name: Size
entries.text: Dwarves stand between 4 and 5 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries.text: Your base walking speed is 25 feet. Your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.text: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.text: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Dwarven Combat Training
entries.text: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries.text: You gain proficiency with the artisan’s tools of your choice: smith’s tools, brewer’s supplies, or mason’s tools.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries.text: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Languages
entries.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish. Dwarvish is full of hard consonants and guttural sounds, and those characteristics spill over into whatever other language a dwarf might speak.

entries.name: Hill Dwarf
entries.summary: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries.text: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Fighter
entries.summary: As a fighter, you gain the following class features.

attributes.dnd5e.skillChoices: Choose two skills from Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, and Survival

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.text: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

entries.name: Action Surge
entries.text:
Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

entries.name: Martial Archetype
entries.text: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques, such as Champion. The archetype you choose grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can’t increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.text:
Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.
